claim: Patchline ships an open-problem bounty board with gate-checkable success criteria and reproducible submissions. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the bounty board claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make open-problem-bounty-board-gate`.
